lines.en: Bia, this is our last class of the block. Looking back, I have learned a great deal of useful English.
lines.pt: Bia, esta é a nossa última aula do bloco. Olhando para trás, aprendi muito inglês útil.

lines.en: Me too. At the beginning, a large number of structures confused me, but now each of them feels clearer.
lines.pt: Eu também. No começo, um grande número de estruturas me confundia, mas agora cada uma delas parece mais clara.

lines.en: I used to say less people. Now I say fewer people, and the mistake has almost disappeared.
lines.pt: Eu dizia less people. Agora digo fewer people, e o erro quase desapareceu.

lines.en: My best progress is with get. Last week I told my boss that the report got delayed, and he understood.
lines.pt: Meu maior progresso é com get. Semana passada disse ao meu chefe que o relatório atrasou, e ele entendeu.

lines.en: Nice. I also use in case more often. Yesterday I took a charger in case my phone died.
lines.pt: Legal. Também uso in case com mais frequência. Ontem levei um carregador caso meu celular morresse.

lines.en: The majority of our classmates say that both of the units were hard, but the practice helped a great deal.
lines.pt: A maioria dos nossos colegas diz que as duas unidades foram difíceis, mas a prática ajudou muito.

lines.en: True. If I had started earlier, I would have learned even more, but it is too late to change that now.
lines.pt: Verdade. Se eu tivesse começado antes, teria aprendido ainda mais, mas é tarde demais para mudar isso agora.

lines.en: Do not be so hard on yourself. You got promoted at work last month, and part of that is your English.
lines.pt: Não seja tão dura consigo mesma. Você foi promovida no trabalho no mês passado, e parte disso é seu inglês.

lines.en: Thanks. My manager told me that my emails had improved, and that fewer mistakes appear in them now.
lines.pt: Obrigada. Minha gerente me disse que meus e-mails tinham melhorado, e que agora aparecem menos erros neles.

lines.en: That is great. What are you going to do next, now that the block is over?
lines.pt: Que ótimo. O que você vai fazer agora que o bloco acabou?

lines.en: I will keep reading every day, in case I forget something, and I will look for a conversation partner.
lines.pt: Vou continuar lendo todo dia, caso eu esqueça algo, e vou procurar um parceiro de conversa.

facts.label: A última aula do bloco
facts.sub: a great deal of, fewer, got promoted, in case I forget.

facts.label: a great deal of, each of, fewer, less
facts.sub: Use a great deal of com incontáveis e a large number of com contáveis. Each of us has a task. Fewer people, less noise. Cada palavra tem seu tipo de substantivo.

facts.label: got + particípio
facts.sub: Use got + particípio para mudanças e imprevistos: She got promoted. The report got delayed. É informal e foca o resultado.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns.
Got promoted is a get passive.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Fewer goes with uncountable nouns. → Falso (Fewer goes with countable nouns.)
Got promoted is a get passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: What I have learned · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny afternoon in Houston. Tess arrives early to the classroom. The board still has notes from last week. Some students are already packing their bags. Bia sits next to her friend. They look at their notebooks together.

“Bia, this is our last class of the block. Looking back, I have learned a great deal of useful English.” says Tess. “Me too. At the beginning, a large number of structures confused me, but now each of them feels clearer.” says Bia. “I used to say less people. Now I say fewer people, and the mistake has almost disappeared.” says Tess.
